locator.text: Display 44.4, p. 44, in the statement of Lemma 4.9

evidence: paper: A_n = n_\theta + t_s n_z, \qquad B_n = n_z - t_s n_\theta .

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The two bilinear forms are literally the Lean definitions: `stockProjection p q t = p + q*t` is A_n and `stockCross p q t = q - p*t` is B_n, at (p,q) = (n_θ, n_z) and t = t_s. The one encoding difference is where these two named definitions are instantiated. Every occurrence of `stockProjection`/`stockCross` in the repository is in ActivationCone.lean, and each is at a *stock* pair rather than at a unit vector: :347,349 and :413,415 (error transport, at the stock coordinates A + z·dA, B + z·dB with tilt (B/A)(1 + z·dR)) and :459,464 (`activatedProjection`/`activatedCross`, at `activatedStockOne`/`activatedStockTwo` with `shearSlope`). At that instantiation the pair is the paper's P_c and J_c of (4.20) — the same bilinear form evaluated at the stock pair p_s, not at the unit n — so the form at n is never given a name of its own. It appears only in two other guises: written out as the inner products a·A_n and a·B_n inside `targetCone_of_signedShear`, and in tilt form as `directionProjection`/`directionGap` at the unit `unitOfTilt t` (ActiveAnnulusWeight, a different namespace). The inner-product form: `targetCone_of_signedShear` has, at ProfileSpectralCone.lean:150-158, the identities ⟪T, normalDirection (F•!₂[-a,-c])⟫ = -(F/‖·‖)(a T₀ + c T₁) and ⟪T, transverseDirection (F•!₂[-a,-c])⟫ = (F/‖·‖)(a T₁ - c T₀), which at T = n and t_s = c/a are a·A_n and a·B_n. Rewriting from the tilt form: with t = n_z/n_θ, A_n = (1 + t_s t)/√(1+t²) = directionProjection t_s t / √(1+t²) and B_n = (t - t_s)/√(1+t²), valid where n_θ > 0; the tilt-form quantities are therefore the paper's A_n, B_n times the common positive factor √(1+t²), so signs and the ratio B_n/A_n are unchanged.
